topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 68 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 27 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 3 ERC1155 multi-tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20burnable, erc20permit, eip712). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
